Subject: MAP checkpoint — proposed host rotation and time options

Hi Rishi / Lauren,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We're working through the MAP and want to lock a recurring 30-min checkpoint to keep the evaluation moving and align on the close timeline. A couple of asks:

- Can we rotate the meeting host between FinText and Redwood each week so key stakeholders can surface feedback?
- We have teammates in CET and APAC who need different window options — are there two candidate slots you can propose?
- Please attach the latest MAP and the draft SOW so our procurement/CS teams can review ahead of the call.

I've attached our latest internal MAP (FinText-MAP-v3.xlsx) which has a short list of evaluation KPIs. Proposed high-level agenda:
- 5m quick status (open items)
- 10m evaluation gaps + owners
- 10m deployment/infra Qs
- 5m next steps and dates

Would Monday 10:00am PST (18:00 CET) or Tuesday 2:00pm PST (22:00 CET) work on your side for next week's rotation? If neither, please propose two alternatives.

Thanks,
Olivia Park
Head of Integrations, FinText
olivia@fintext.com

Olivia — thanks for the note and the MAP. Appreciate the clear agenda.

We can absolutely rotate hosts. Proposal from our side: Lauren will host the first checkpoint (internal kickoff), then FinText hosts week 2. We'll keep a shared running agenda in the MAP workbook.

Time options I can confirm right now:
- Option A: Monday 10:00am PST / 18:00 CET (30 min) — works for Lauren and Naomi
- Option B: Tuesday 2:00pm PST / 22:00 CET — less ideal for APAC but doable on alternate weeks

Lauren, Naomi — can you confirm which slot you prefer to host next week?

Action items I propose we capture before the first checkpoint:
- Redwood: send SOW draft + short rollout notes (owner: Rishi) — attached SOW_FinText_v0.9.pdf
- FinText: finalize evaluation KPI owners in the MAP sheet (owner: Olivia) — referenced in their attachment
- Redwood CS (Naomi): prepare short checklist for infra prerequisites (owner: Naomi)

I'll create a calendar hold once we lock the slot — sharing a tentative invite now: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=fintext-map-checkpoint

If Lauren prefers, she can host and run the first 15 minutes covering evaluation KPIs; we'll have a short SOW review in the second half.
